lines.zh: 板甲很沉，每一步都碾碎石块
lines.en: Full plate is heavy; each step grinds the stones.

lines.zh: 巨盔只剩一道缝，风从缝里钻
lines.en: My great helm leaves one slit, and wind slips in.

lines.zh: 我拖着长剑走过锻炉旁
lines.en: I drag my long sword past the forge.

lines.zh: 甲片相撞，声如铁砧连敲
lines.en: The plates clash like a hammer on the anvil.

lines.zh: 二十点护甲，走起来像铁塔
lines.en: Twenty armor, walking like an iron tower.

lines.zh: 靴底压过草地，草茎齐齐折断
lines.en: My boots flatten the grass stems as I pass.

lines.zh: 我沿城墙巡行，甲缝透进冷风
lines.en: I patrol the wall; cold air seeps through seams.

lines.zh: 长剑垂在身侧，剑尖划过泥土
lines.en: Sword at my side, its tip scoring the dirt.

lines.zh: 护手上还留着炙铁的味道
lines.en: The smell of hot iron still clings to my gauntlet.

lines.zh: 沉重脚步震得碎石轻轻跳起
lines.en: Heavy strides make the gravel hop.

lines.zh: 我把巨盔扶正，继续往前
lines.en: I set my great helm straight and walk on.

lines.zh: 板甲磨着肩骨，一路作响
lines.en: Plate grinds my collarbone all the way.

lines.zh: 我立在原地，像一尊铸好的铁像
lines.en: I stand still, a freshly cast iron statue.

lines.zh: 长剑插地，双手压在剑柄上
lines.en: Sword in the earth, both hands on the pommel.

lines.zh: 巨盔里的呼吸闷闷地回响
lines.en: My breath booms dully inside the helm.

lines.zh: 锻打过的甲面映着天光
lines.en: The hammered plate mirrors the daylight.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只听风穿过缝隙
lines.en: I hold still and listen to wind through gaps.

lines.zh: 二十点护甲让我懒得躲闪
lines.en: Twenty armor makes me too lazy to dodge.

lines.zh: 甲里的汗水慢慢凉下来
lines.en: Sweat inside the armor slowly cools.

lines.zh: 我数着远处铁砧的敲击声
lines.en: I count the hammer blows far away.

lines.zh: 铁手套握着剑柄，纹丝不动
lines.en: My gauntlet holds the hilt, not a twitch.

lines.zh: 我像等待号令的守夜人
lines.en: I wait like a watchman for the horn.

lines.zh: 淬火的嘶声还在耳边作响
lines.en: The hiss of quenching still rings in my ears.

lines.zh: 巨盔低垂，我打了个盹
lines.en: My helm dips; I doze.

lines.zh: 巨盔转向你，缝里两点寒光
lines.en: The helm turns; two cold lights in its slit.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，估量你甲有多厚
lines.en: I eye you, judging how thick your armor is.

lines.zh: 你在我剑程之内，别乱动
lines.en: You are within my reach; do not move.

lines.zh: 我抬起目光，甲片随之轻响
lines.en: I lift my gaze; the plates chime softly.

lines.zh: 这么单薄的皮甲，也敢来?
lines.en: Cloth armor like that, and you come here?

lines.zh: 我从头到脚把你打量一遍
lines.en: I size you up from helm to boot.

lines.zh: 巨盔下的眼睛一次没眨
lines.en: The eyes beneath my helm never blink.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里那块铁器
lines.en: I recognize the iron in your hand.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，凡人
lines.en: You stand too close, mortal.

lines.zh: 我把长剑从土里缓缓拔出
lines.en: Slowly I draw my sword from the soil.

lines.zh: 目光落在你喉咙的高度
lines.en: My gaze settles at the height of your throat.

lines.zh: 我沉默地看着，等你先动
lines.en: I watch in silence, waiting for you to move.

lines.zh: 甲片被砸出一个坑
lines.en: A dent is smashed into my plate.

lines.zh: 巨盔歪了，耳朵嗡嗡响
lines.en: My helm is knocked askew and my ears ring.

lines.zh: 剑差点脱手，我握得更紧
lines.en: The sword nearly slips; I grip harder.

lines.zh: 这一下打穿了我的甲缝
lines.en: That blow found the seam in my plate.

lines.zh: 我闷哼一声，铁腥味涌上喉咙
lines.en: I grunt; the taste of iron rises in my throat.

lines.zh: 膝盖一软，甲压得更沉
lines.en: My knee buckles and the plate weighs more.

lines.zh: 甲下的肉比甲薄多了
lines.en: The flesh beneath the plate is far thinner.

lines.zh: 我退了半步才站稳
lines.en: I take a step back before I find my footing.

lines.zh: 锻过的手也会疼
lines.en: Even hammered hands can hurt.

lines.zh: 血顺着甲缝淌进靴子
lines.en: Blood runs down the seam into my boot.

lines.zh: 面包香钻进了巨盔的缝隙
lines.en: Bread smell slips through my helm's slit.

lines.zh: 你手里那块烤肉，闻着不坏
lines.en: That roast in your hand smells decent.

lines.zh: 我停下脚步，鼻子动了动
lines.en: I halt and my nose twitches.

lines.zh: 打了一整天铁，我饿得发慌
lines.en: A whole day at the forge leaves me starving.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的干粮袋不放
lines.en: I fix my eyes on your ration sack.

lines.zh: 甲胄再厚也挡不住饥饿
lines.en: No armor is thick enough to stop hunger.

lines.zh: 我伸手，又想起自己戴着铁手套
lines.en: I reach out, then recall my gauntlet.

lines.zh: 这味道比锻炉的烟好闻多了
lines.en: Better than forge smoke, this smell.

lines.zh: 我挪近半步，剑尖垂了下去
lines.en: I edge closer; my sword tip drops.

lines.zh: 分我一口，我就少砍你一剑
lines.en: Share a bite and I swing one less time.

lines.zh: 铁肩撞上你，像被城墙顶了一下
lines.en: My iron shoulder hits like a castle wall.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，甲片哗啦作响
lines.en: We collide, and the plate clatters loud.

lines.zh: 你撞在板甲上，连退两步
lines.en: You hit my plate and stagger back two steps.

lines.zh: 我纹丝不动，你却被弹开
lines.en: I do not budge; you bounce off instead.

lines.zh: 巨盔磕到你的额头
lines.en: My great helm knocks against your brow.

lines.zh: 别挤，二十点护甲不是软的
lines.en: Do not shove; twenty armor is not soft.

lines.zh: 相撞一瞬，我听见你闷哼
lines.en: At the impact I hear you grunt.

lines.zh: 剑鞘磕在你肋骨上
lines.en: My scabbard raps against your ribs.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的铁靴，脚趾该疼了
lines.en: You stepped on my sabaton; your toes must ache.

lines.zh: 两副甲撞出的响声惊飞了鸟
lines.en: Two armors clashing startle the birds away.

lines.zh: 两副板甲并排，像两面墙
lines.en: Two suits of plate side by side, like walls.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只让甲片相碰
lines.en: We say nothing, letting our plates touch.

lines.zh: 她摘下一半巨盔，我别开眼
lines.en: She lifts her helm halfway; I look aside.

lines.zh: 铁与铁之间，也有安静的时辰
lines.en: Even iron and iron have quiet hours.

lines.zh: 我替她系紧背后的甲扣
lines.en: I cinch the buckle at her back.

lines.zh: 锻炉的火照着两副甲
lines.en: The forge fire lights both our armors.

lines.zh: 并肩站着，就是骑士的誓言
lines.en: Standing shoulder to shoulder is a knight's vow.

lines.zh: 她的剑与我的剑靠在一处
lines.en: Her sword rests against mine.

lines.zh: 甲太厚，拥抱只剩碰撞声
lines.en: Plate too thick; a hug is only a clatter.

lines.zh: 我们约好明日一同巡城
lines.en: We agree to patrol the walls tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我弯腰拾起一枚掉落的铁钉
lines.en: I stoop and pick up a fallen iron nail.

lines.zh: 铁手套捏起面包，差点捏碎
lines.en: My gauntlet lifts the bread and nearly crushes it.

lines.zh: 我捡起地上的剑鞘扣环
lines.en: I pick a scabbard ring out of the dirt.

lines.zh: 谁把铁锭丢在这儿? 我收了
lines.en: Who dropped this ingot? Mine now.

lines.zh: 拾起磨刀石，我塞进腰袋
lines.en: I pocket a whetstone.

lines.zh: 我蹲下，板甲咔咔作响
lines.en: I crouch, and my plate creaks.

lines.zh: 这块布正好拿来擦剑
lines.en: This cloth will do for wiping the blade.

lines.zh: 我拾起你掉的钱袋，掂了掂
lines.en: I pick up your dropped purse and weigh it.

lines.zh: 巨盔挡着视线，我摸了两下才拿到
lines.en: My helm blocks the view; I grope twice to get it.

lines.zh: 捡起一小块煤，锻炉还缺火
lines.en: I grab a lump of coal; the forge needs fire.

lines.zh: 我把你记进了剑的名单
lines.en: I have written you into my sword's list.

lines.zh: 巨盔一低，目标就定了
lines.en: My helm dips, and the target is set.

lines.zh: 你那一抖，让我选中了你
lines.en: That flinch of yours chose you.

lines.zh: 长剑抬到肩高，我锁定了你
lines.en: Sword at shoulder height, I have you.

lines.zh: 锻炉教我第一件事: 找准落点
lines.en: The forge taught me first: find the spot.

lines.zh: 你身上没甲，省了我力气
lines.en: No armor on you; that saves me effort.

lines.zh: 我迈出第一步，地面轻震
lines.en: I take my first step; the ground trembles.

lines.zh: 别跑，甲慢，剑却够长
lines.en: Do not run; my armor is slow, my sword is long.

lines.zh: 视线死死钉住你的动作
lines.en: My gaze nails your every movement.

lines.zh: 这一战，我接下来了
lines.en: This fight, I accept.

lines.zh: 铁手套收紧，指节发响
lines.en: My gauntlet tightens; the knuckles crack.

lines.zh: 你已踏进我的剑程
lines.en: You have stepped into my reach.

lines.zh: 我压低巨盔，护住面门
lines.en: I lower my helm to guard my face.

lines.zh: 目标确认，剑锋朝前
lines.en: Target confirmed; the blade points forward.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，不快，但不停
lines.en: I follow, not fast, but never stopping.

lines.zh: 每一步都在缩短我们之间的距离
lines.en: Each step shortens the space between us.

lines.zh: 你绕左，我就转向左
lines.en: You go left; I turn left.

lines.zh: 板甲拖着重音，我追着你的影子
lines.en: Plate dragging heavy, I chase your shadow.

lines.zh: 我算着你下一脚会落在哪儿
lines.en: I reckon where your next foot will land.

lines.zh: 别指望跑赢一副铁甲
lines.en: Do not hope to outrun a suit of iron.

lines.zh: 剑尖始终对着你的胸口
lines.en: The point stays level with your chest.

lines.zh: 我压住呼吸，等你露破绽
lines.en: I steady my breath and wait for a gap.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我便笑了
lines.en: You back into a corner, and I smile.

lines.zh: 锻打要一遍遍，追杀也一样
lines.en: Forging repeats; so does hunting.

lines.zh: 我的脚步震得你手在抖
lines.en: My tread makes your hands shake.

lines.zh: 你举高盾牌，我改劈小腿
lines.en: You raise the shield; I aim for your legs.

lines.zh: 汗水在甲里淌，我不擦
lines.en: Sweat runs inside my armor; I do not wipe it.

lines.zh: 七步距离，正好一剑
lines.en: Seven paces is exactly one sword away.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊话浪费气力
lines.en: I do not shout; shouting wastes breath.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我的巨盔跟着转
lines.en: You change direction; my helm follows.

lines.zh: 这场追逐只会有一种结局
lines.en: This chase can end only one way.

lines.zh: 长剑横劈，铁风扑面而来
lines.en: My long sword sweeps; iron wind fills your face.

lines.zh: 我压低重心，一剑直取
lines.en: I drop my weight and thrust straight in.

lines.zh: 甲片一响，剑已经落下
lines.en: The plate clanks, and the blade comes down.

lines.zh: 这一记，是锤下练出来的
lines.en: This blow was learned beneath the hammer.

lines.zh: 剑刃擦着你的肩膀过去
lines.en: The edge scrapes past your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我用剑柄撞你的下巴
lines.en: I drive the pommel into your chin.

lines.zh: 巨盔顶过来，你眼前一黑
lines.en: My helm slams down; your sight goes black.

lines.zh: 铁靴踹出，正中心口
lines.en: An iron boot kicks square into your chest.

lines.zh: 你挡得住剑，挡不住甲的重量
lines.en: Block the blade; you cannot block the weight.

lines.zh: 一剑劈开你的木盾
lines.en: One swing splits your wooden shield.

lines.zh: 长剑回撩，割开你的衣角
lines.en: A backswing cuts open your hem.

lines.zh: 剑尖点在你的护腕上，火星四溅
lines.en: The point strikes your bracer; sparks fly.

lines.zh: 我整个人压上去，剑刃贴身
lines.en: I lean my whole body in, blade close.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就跟进一剑
lines.en: You step back; I follow with a cut.

lines.zh: 这一剑偏了，但够重
lines.en: This one is off line, but heavy enough.

lines.zh: 我再补上一记铁肘
lines.en: I add an iron elbow on top.

lines.zh: 铁手套砸在你执械的手上
lines.en: My gauntlet smashes your weapon hand.

lines.zh: 收剑，抹掉刃上的水光
lines.en: I draw back and wipe the blade clean.

lines.zh: 锻炉的火熄了，我从烟里走出
lines.en: The forge dies; I walk out of the smoke.

lines.zh: 铁砧最后一声，我睁开眼
lines.en: The anvil's last ring opens my eyes.

lines.zh: 板甲一节节扣合，我站直
lines.en: Plate locks joint by joint; I straighten up.

lines.zh: 我来了，带着一身新锻的甲
lines.en: I arrive in freshly hammered plate.

lines.zh: 巨盔落下，世界暗了一瞬
lines.en: My great helm settles; the world dims.

lines.zh: 长剑出鞘，声音像裂冰
lines.en: The sword leaves its sheath like cracking ice.

lines.zh: 二十点护甲，从头武装到脚
lines.en: Twenty armor, armed from head to heel.

lines.zh: 我从城墙的阴影里踏出来
lines.en: I step out of the wall's shadow.

lines.zh: 有人把铁烧红了，于是我醒
lines.en: Someone heated the iron; so I woke.

lines.zh: 淬火的嘶声，是我登场的前奏
lines.en: The hiss of quench is my overture.

lines.zh: 我踩着碎铁屑走进这片地
lines.en: I walk in over a floor of iron shavings.

lines.zh: 要问姓名? 不必，甲会说话
lines.en: My name? No need; the armor speaks.

lines.zh: 火舌舔上甲面，铁烫得贴不住
lines.en: Flame licks my plate; the iron grows too hot to bear.

lines.zh: 从高处砸落，甲先着地
lines.en: I crash down from above, plate first.

lines.zh: 水灌进巨盔，我咳得发闷
lines.en: Water floods my helm and my cough is muffled.

lines.zh: 爆风把我连人带甲掀翻
lines.en: The blast flips me over, armor and all.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡进甲缝里
lines.en: An arrow lodges in the seam of my plate.

lines.zh: 咒力钻进甲里，骨头跟着发冷
lines.en: Magic seeps through the steel and my bones chill.

lines.zh: 空腹穿重甲，腿在发抖
lines.en: Fasting in heavy plate, my legs tremble.

lines.zh: 雷顺着长剑钻进我手臂
lines.en: Lightning runs down my sword into my arm.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，甲坠得比人快
lines.en: The ground is gone; my armor falls faster than I do.
